pre_execution_plan_revision.reason: Pre-execution metadata-only revision: root selected full32/four rates and balanced forward/reverse condition order; launches unchanged. Superseded plans were not executed.

purpose: Independent broader paired test after separately budget-matched frontend tuning; no outcome-based case filtering or subsequent tuning

source.RNG_note: Distribution formulas and conditional offsets match pinned source. Parameter RNG is a separate preregistered stratified sampler, not a bitwise replay of upstream reset RNG.

sampling.factors: x4 x height2 x horizontal_magnitude2 x y2 =32 equally weighted strata
sampling.conditional_offsets: vy-=0.4 when y>2.25; vz+=1 when height<1.0; azimuth is independent of x, no lane or centre-directed correction

reset_randomization.mechanism: Existing runner seeds the normal reset and calls original_random_pose first, then overrides position/velocity only. Original release/quaternion/gravity/PID/noise RNG sequence is retained.
reset_randomization.audit: Log actual reset release time and world gravity after runtime reset; require exact equality within every paired block. Public world gravity may remain a shared estimator input; release must be scoring-only.
reset_randomization.coverage: Release-time spread is not guaranteed by offline metadata. Report its observed span without replacing any seed.

fixed_scene.initialization: one actual rendered RGB-D frame; then events and robot proprioception

frontend_lock.requirement: Each selected frontend config and code hash, tuning-bank hash, candidate budget, and selected result must be frozen before any blind outcome. No blind outcomes may be used for selection.

budget_preset_A.rule: Unused historical budget preset only; full32 was explicitly selected, so this must not become result-dependent early stopping

evaluation.reference_reuse: Run each reference once per block; reuse across source rates because it consumes no subsequent event stream. Do not count reuse as new episodes.
evaluation.independence: 32 independent seed blocks, each repeated across eight primary conditions; cadence repetitions are not new independent cases.
evaluation.primary_score: Original2.5s horizon AND not terminated AND actual hand contact occurred AND final40ms controller step contains hand contact; retain all raw flags
evaluation.retain: All initialization failures, non-reachable throws, GT-policy failures and method failures remain in denominator; no GT filtering or fallback. Infrastructure retries preserve same seed/config and original attempt.
